interval_years.quote: A license to practice optometry in the state may be issued for one year only.

required.quote: A license may be renewed by submitting to the board, during December of each year, the license fee for the following year and satisfactory proof the licensee has met all continuing education conditions set by the board.

available.quote: An applicant may secure a license to practice optometry in this state without taking all required examinations as follows: Presentation of a certified copy or an original certificate of registration or license in good standing issued to the applicant by another state where the requirements for license are equivalent to those of this state;

requirements.value: Applicant must present a license in good standing from a state with equivalent requirements, apply for the highest level of therapeutic licensure, be current in CE requirements of current state, pass a ND state optometry law examination, have a minimum of four years of practice/federal service/teaching experience, have no grounds for disciplinary action, and submit to an oral interview. Board may also require a practical examination.
requirements.quote: Unless waived by the board, all applicants for licensure by endorsement must: a. Apply for the highest level of therapeutic licensure in this state. b. Be current in the continuing education requirements of their current state of licensure. c. Pass a North Dakota state optometry law examination as required by the board to be given at such times and places as are prescribed by the board. d. Have a minimum of four years of practice, federal service, or teaching experience as a licensed optometrist prior to making application.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provisions of this chapter, the rules and regulations of the board, or committed an offense determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon a holder's ability to serve the public as an optometrist

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is engaged in the practice of optometry by being directly or indirectly employed by any person other than a licensed optometrist, a physician licensed under chapter 43-17, a hospital, or a clinic operated by licensed optometrists or by licensed physicians.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical ability to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety is impaired.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board may restrict, suspend, or revoke the license of any licensed optometrist whose mental or physical ability to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety is impaired.

definition_quote.value: "Diagnosis and treatment" means the determination, interpretation, and treatment of any visual, muscular, neurological, interpretative, or anatomical anomaly of the eye which may be aided, relieved, or corrected through visual training procedures or through the use of lenses, prisms, filters, ophthalmic instruments, pharmaceutical agents, or combinations thereof, held either in contact with the eye, or in frames or mountings, as further authorized by this chapter. Laser therapy and the use of invasive surgery are not permitted under this chapter, except superficial foreign bodies may be removed and primary care procedures may be performed.
definition_quote.quote: "Diagnosis and treatment" means the determination, interpretation, and treatment of any visual, muscular, neurological, interpretative, or anatomical anomaly of the eye which may be aided, relieved, or corrected through visual training procedures or through the use of lenses, prisms, filters, ophthalmic instruments, pharmaceutical agents, or combinations thereof, held either in contact with the eye, or in frames or mountings, as further authorized by this chapter. Laser therapy and the use of invasive surgery are not permitted under this chapter, except superficial foreign bodies may be removed and primary care procedures may be performed.

methods_authorized.quote: through visual training procedures or through the use of lenses, prisms, filters, ophthalmic instruments, pharmaceutical agents, or combinations thereof

drug_authority.value: Pharmaceutical agents including diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (anesthetics, mydriatics, myotics, cycloplegics, diagnostic dyes, diagnostic stains, agents to evaluate abnormal pupil responses) and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (topical, locally administered, oral anti-infective, oral antihistaminic, oral analgesics for ocular-related disorders). Includes nonscheduled pharmaceutical agents except acetaminophen with 30mg codeine. Optometrists may not dispense therapeutic pharmaceutical agents except as drug samples or contact lenses/ophthalmic devices classified as drugs by FDA.
drug_authority.quote: "Pharmaceutical agent" means diagnostic pharmaceutical agents or therapeutic pharmaceutical agents. The term includes nonscheduled pharmaceutical agents, except for acetaminophen with thirty milligrams of codeine, that have documented use in the treatment of ocular-related disorders or diseases.
